paragraph: Emerson is a single-family market, effectively all of it, with 33 sales over six months at a median of $845,000 against a median list of $815,000. The sale-to-list ratio is 1.036, roughly 70 percent of homes sold above asking, and the median days on market is 16. That is a real seller's market, and buyers should expect competition on the good ones. The typical sale is a four-bedroom colonial, ranch, or split-level with two full baths, and prices ran from $520,000 up to $1,240,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. Month to month, most of the sample is too thin to read, but volume built to 14 closings in July, which tracks the normal early-to-mid summer peak. If Emerson follows the usual arc, expect closings to taper through fall and thin out in deep winter.
